summary: You delivered a strong, coherent GBR Earth-observation mission with fluid lensing. You met all core requirements with STK evidence. To strengthen, correct key orbital terminology and SSO launch physics, clean STK outputs, and tighten referencing and figure numbering for a fully professional finish.
next_steps: In Mission Design - Orbit, replace Argument of Latitude u with ω and ν for circular orbits, and define RAAN correctly - it is not launch site latitude. Add a brief note if you use u as alternative.

In Mission Design - Launch, qualify the equatorial benefit for your retrograde SSO - explain why Guiana is still chosen despite rotation penalty, and add a simple delta-V and mass/margin budget for Vega E vs Vega C fallback.

In Ground Control & Communications and Bibliography, remove duplicate/timing errors in your access report (Image 1) with a 1-sentence quality check, fix figure numbering, and replace Wikipedia with primary sources per guidance.

criteria.C1: You addressed all 4 items well: coral reef monitoring purpose, acidity/bleaching rationale, single-sat justification for simplicity, and CSIRO/BOM users with university operator. For top of Accomplished, deepen literature support for user needs and payload requirement.
criteria.C2: Excellent work covering Vega E from Guiana with trade study, SSO table with a=6971km and i=97.79° vs altitude plot, STK screenshots, and 5 passes/day ~580s plus 5-yr life and drag sail EOL. Next level needs corrected u definition, RAAN concept, SSO launch physics, and delta-V/mass budget.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion effectively synthesises evidence: Vega E selection with Vega C risk, polar SSO for illumination, comms frequency and EOL. To reach higher Accomplished, quantify key residual impacts for Australia and final requirements closure.
criteria.C4: Clear report structure with Executive Summary, TOC, headed sections, and captioned STK figures. For higher Accomplished, make figure numbering sequential, ensure all references are authoritative per guidance, and proof Table 1 consistency.
